events.text: Josidiah Starym embarks on a quest to find the lost Soldier's Blade to prove his worthiness to marry Aravae Irithyl, the Coronal of Myth Drannor's daughter, heir to the throne, and Josidiah's true love.
cites: The Fall of Myth Drannor, с. 4
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 88

events.text: Josidiah leads a band of bladesingers and Akh'Faer against the drow of the Twisted Tower, where the Soldier's Blade had been lost. The drow are temporarily defeated, Josidiah and his band journey into the Underdark below the tower.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 88

events.text: High King Carrig Cymrych III of the Moonshae Isles is assassinated.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 32

cites: Lands of Intrigue: Amn, с. 21

events.text: The Tashlutan merchant consortium known as the Rundeen monopolizes all trade in and out of the ports of Calimshan and the Chultan Peninsula. They also monopolize the slave trade along southern coast of the Shining Sea.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 88

events.text: A squad of halfling scouts of the Akh'Velahr defeat a large camp of Moander worshipers near the god's ruined temple and tomb. These seven halflings become famous as the Heroes of Myth Drannor, with two going on to become the first halfling soldiers of Myth Drannor at the invitation of Coronal Eltargrim Irithyl.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 88

events.text: A Treatise toward Unity: Comparisons of the People and Humanity in Art and Life, a book written by Arun Maerdrymm of Myth Drannor, is published.

cites: The Candlekeep Collection

events.text: Unther launches a campaign to retake the rebellious cities of Wizards' Reach, now known as the the League of Samathar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 88

cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 88
Old Empires, с. 5

events.text: Colin Cymrych becomes High King of the Moonshae Isles. The regency of Edmund Kincaid ends.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 32

events.text: An orc horde overruns the realm of Elembar. However, the capital of Delimbiyran and its environs survive intact, as the orc horde is halted at the House of Stone.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 88

events.text: The struggle for power over Najara that commenced with the death of Jacinica finally ends as Nejizar at last takes the throne.

In Shou Lung, the Sixteenth Emperor Chin of the Kao Dynasty decrees The Revealing of Scrolls, which encourages intellectual discussion and the founding of many rival schools. This triggers a golden age for astronomy, alchemy, and geomancy. Meanwhile, missionary priests of the Path of Enlightenment are sent out to far-flung lands such as Kozakura to establish shrines.
In Kozakura, the teachings of the Path of Enlightenment are introduced; locally, it is called the "Way of Enlightenment".
cites: Swords of the Daimyo, с. 17

events.text: Candlekairn clan of orcs gathers into a horde and emerges from the Orsraun Mountains to raze a number of Turmish cities in what would become known as the War of 512. They are at last routed in late summer.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 89
The Vilhon Reach: Dungeon Master's Reference, с. 9

events.text: The orc realm of Vastar is on the rampage again, with orc hordes from here and other strongholds emerging and threatening Cormanthyr and many other lands with war. Swarming through many small passes of the Earthspur Mountains, the orc chieftain Ulbror and his horde invade the uplands of Impiltur. There, the orcs slay King Sharaun Mirandor, his three heirs and their army, killing off the Mirandor dynasty. However, Ulbror and the orcs are defeated later that year by another army mustered by Duke Harandil Durlaven, being routed at the Battle of Bloody Reeds.
cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 40
Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 128
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 89

events.text: On the battlefield, Harandil is crowned as king of Impiltur. He founds the Durlarven Dynasty.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 89

events.text: The city of Esmeltaran is established as Amn's new capital, under the rule of King Imnel I.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 89

events.text: The Decrees of Onsruur are published without fanfare in Khôltar. They codify what was already the de facto laws of the city.
cites: Elminster Speaks archive, с. 85
Elminster Speaks: Part 64: Khôltar, Part 15, A Brief History of Khôltar, Part 2

events.text: The end of the official reign of King Galaghard I of Cormyr. He actually took the identity of his son with the help of royal wizard Amedahast to prolong his life.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 77

events.text: Fleeing persecutions ordered by the Duke of Cortryn, a realm east of Amn, many halflings led by Bellabar Huntinghorn leave Meiritin. They settle with other halflings by the Delimbiyr River, near what is later Secomber.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 90

events.text: Gordon Cymrych, future High King of the Moonshae Isles, is born to Colin Cymrych.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 32

cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 90

events.text: The halfing peoples in Delimbiyr Vale join humans from Delimbiyran and found Secomber. It lies on the ruins of Hastarl.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 90

events.text: In the Orsraun Mountains, Mount Andrus erupts. This further devastates the Candlekairn orcs.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 90

events.text: Reinhar II of Dambrath is born.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 77–78

events.text: Bigoted elves of House Selorn assassinate Sammkol Thistlestar, a halfling soldier of Myth Drannor. They then frame and murder a visiting human necromancer from Cormyr for the crime.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 90

events.text: The Shou Lung province of Yu' I erupts into rebellion against over-taxation. Though the rebellion is crushed, the Emperor reduces the number of troops garrisoning the Tabot border in the hope of easing tensions between the people and the state. This leads to a greater amount of self-determination for the people of Yu' I in the future.
cites: Kara-Tur: The Eastern Realms: Volume I, с. 13

events.text: Druidic and elven emissaries from Gulthmere and Xorhun petition Alaghôn to curb their logging so the forest can regrow. Arton Githsberry, ruler of Turmish, makes a show of his consideration by convening a council of his lords but has no intention of actually acting upon their request.
cites: The Vilhon Reach: Dungeon Master's Reference, с. 9

events.text: At the Council of Axe and Arrow, the Kingdom of Phalorm is founded in northwest Faerûn in response to increasing orcish power. The elves of Ardeep, the dwarves of Dardath, the humans of Delimbiyran, the gnomes of Dolblunde, and the halflings displaced from Meiritin unite in the Realm of Three Crowns. Ulbaerag Bloodhand rejects the invitation for Bloodhand Hold to join the kingdom.
cites: City of Splendors: Waterdeep, с. 8
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 90

events.text: Phalorm lays claim to the High Moor and commences construction of a chain of fortresses along the western border with the Serpent Hills.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 90

events.text: Aided by an alliance with a dozen spirit naga, the dark naga Nejizar takes power over the serpentfolk of the Serpent Hills. Their aims are hindered by Phalorm's expansion.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 90

events.text: The Starym moon elf clan returns to Myth Drannor and re-establishes itself as an important house without Josidiah Starym.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 90

events.text: Lord Illitran Starym leaves Myth Drannor on a Cleansing March, which has the aim of purify his spirit and preparing him to wield a moonblade. However, he journeys to an abandoned temple of Moander and makes a pact with the imprisoned Rotting God that allows him to draw the blade without its retribution.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 90

events.text: The merchant Urabbastrar Tholokh excavates the tunnels of the Underdark beneath the realm of Chessenta using the Crown of the Mountain. He delves too deep and is killed by a swarm of carrion crawlers.
cites: Dragon 257: Wyrms of the North: Valamaradace
Wyrms of the North: Valamaradace, "the Dragon Queen"

events.text: Slavery and other abuses committed by the Dukes of Cortryn result in Meiritin being abandoned.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 90

cites: Dungeon 73: Eye of Myrkul, с. 45–46

cites: Calimport, с. 22

cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 90

events.text: Fighting at the House of Stone, the armies of Phalorm are victorious over the Howltusk orc horde. However, the human King Javilarhh Snowsword dies in battle.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 90

events.text: Kuo-toa establish the city of Looblishar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 90

events.text: Mameluk slave warriors in Calimshan revolt and seize control of Calimport and several other major cities.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 90

events.text: The free mameluks found a new country free of slavery. As Calimport was traditionally a port for slavers, the mameluk leaders base their capital in Manshaka, shifting the caleph's throne there. The mameluk leader adopts the title of Murabir, or Warlord, a title not used since the time of Mir.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 90

cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 90

cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 74

cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 90

events.text: The House of Reverence to the Dark Lady, a palatial temple of Shar, is assaulted by adventurers called the Fellowship of Athul's Sash. A wagon train of loot leaves the site, claimed by the last surviving member of the group, Rulgond, who murdered his remaining Fellows out of greed. Among the treasure is Gorothir's Girdle.

events.text: To prevent the Dambrathan invasion of Halruaa, the wizard Mycontil Sulaziir and his apprentices sacrifice themselves to defeat King Reinhar I. With his father's death, Reinhar II takes command of the army and retreats to Dambrath.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 90

cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 90

cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 90

cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 90

cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 90

cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 90

events.text: Yuan-ti sent by Nejizar infiltrate the Reaching Woods and incite the hobgoblin tribes there to attack Phalorm. The hobgoblins are driven back and the yuan-ti assassinated. The serpentfolk of Najara fall back into the Serpent Hills.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 90

events.text: The Golden War in Var ends as Muwadeen of Estagund, a retired mercenary, negotiates peace between the warring factions. All three factions—noble, mercantile, and religious—surprisingly agree for once and invite Muwadeen to serve as the Supreme Potentate of Var, assisted by a council of advisers drawn their ranks.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 90

cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes

events.text: Shyressa, then a concubine in a wizard's harem in Lower Tathtar, is embraced by a vampire. Not long after, she proceeded to kill her former master and the harem's 15 other members in a fit of pent-up rage.
cites: Empires of the Shining Sea, с. 184

events.text: Aunrae and Ildibane Nasadra are born. They will become, respectively, the future Matron Mother of House Nasadra and the Archmage of Ched Nasad.

events.text: As one of few trading posts that flourish in the North, Silver Village and becomes Silverymoon. Bynan "Two-Axes" Oakfeller, a local logger known for his kindness, becomes the first mayor of Silverymoon.

The North: Guide to the Savage Frontier: Cities & Civilization, с. 47

events.text: The threat of orcs grows along the northeastern forest of Cormanthor. Myth Drannor makes preparations for war and Pirphal commissions Demron to forge a fifth Baneblade for the Arms-Major of the Akh'Velahr. Dragathil is completed within the year.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 92

events.text: Rulgond, the incredibly wealthy leader of the Black Star Band of adventurers is betrayed by three of his men. Two survive: one, Orgloth claims leadership of the Band and Rulgond's wealth and the other claims Gorothir's Girdle.
cites: Prayers from the Faithful, с. 33

cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 92

Elminster Speaks: Part 64: Khôltar, Part 15, A Brief History of Khôltar, Part 2

cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 92

cites: Swords of the Daimyo, с. 16

cites: The Candlekeep Collection

cites: Sea of Fallen Stars, с. 23, 70, 153

events.text: Aiming to conquer Halagard, capital of Halruaa, a fleet of Dambrathan galleys tries to venture into the channel leading to Lake Halruaa. The Halruaans assault the vessels with magic cast from both land and skyship, destroying nearly the entire fleet.

cites: Drizzt Do'Urden's Guide to the Underdark, с. 50

cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 92

cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 92

cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 42

cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 92

events.text: Orgloth, the leader of the Black Star Band, is crushed under crumbling masonry whilst drunk in a mansion he had just looted. events.text: Alec Cymrych I, future High King of the Moonshae Isles, is born to Embro Cymrych II.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 32

events.text: The four cities of Minsorran on the border of Amn are struck by a terrific blizzard. Trapped by snow for over a month, the entire population fall preys to the white dragon Icehauptannarthanyx. As the snow clears, the cities are found empty and believed to be deserted.
A group of humans, that included the wizard Tharilim of Calimport, die on an expedition in the Spine of the World when the red dragon Hoondarrh devours them.
cites: Dragon 241: Wyrms of the North: Hoondarrh, с. 71

events.text: On a hunting trip in the Gnollwatch Mountains, King Reinhar III of Dambrath is killed by giants, along with his two sons. A short-lived war of succession ensues, but Reinhar's nephew is crowned king, becoming Reinhar IV.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 92

events.text: Circa: In Maztica, human tribes leave the Vale of Ixtzul. The task of guarding the beast H'Calos falls to the Bacar, a species of giant, intelligent ants.

Circa: Modern sailing ships make safe sea travel possible for the first time. Many Faerûnian nations begin to ply the Inner Sea and other seas, though most journeys are still made within sight of land.
Samuel Cymrych, future High King of the Moonshae Isles, is born to Embro Cymrych II.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 32

cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 92

events.text: A pair of ixzan, Phiaqiv the Lifeleech and Zekaqux Netherhaunt, are born and transformed into greater vampires by an avatar of Ilxendren.
cites: Drizzt Do'Urden's Guide to the Underdark, с. 108

events.text: An orc horde lays siege to Secomber before it is driven off by the forces of Phalorm. The elf king of Phalorm, Ellatharion, pursues them into the High Forest with an army of elves and halflings, but they are never seen again.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 92

events.text: Mayor Durind of Silverymoon is found beheaded. Torus, a wealthy livestock merchant, buys the mayorship.
cites: The North: Guide to the Savage Frontier: Cities & Civilization, с. 47

events.text: The people of Thindol discover their nation is rife with yuan-ti infiltrators, from House Sseradess and House Sauringar. Thindol falls into anarchy as the Thindolese spend months searching out and killing serpentfolk.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 92

events.text: Many frightened people of western Thindol decide to flee, sailing a fleet of ships to the isle of Nimbral. However, a storm wrecks many of their vessels on the Beacon Rocks. Lord Samar of Nimbral, sympathetic to their plight and their pleas, returns the refugees to Thindol and agrees to battle the yuan-ti on their behalf.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 92

events.text: In and around Silverymoon, over a dozen people die in suspicious circumstances, including the former mayor Bynan "Son-Axe" Oakfeller and his family whose home is burnt down.
cites: The North: Guide to the Savage Frontier: Cities & Civilization, с. 47

events.text: Reinhar V of Dambrath is born.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 77–78

events.text: Assisted by Lord Samar and forces of Nimbral, the people of western Thindol defeat the yuan-ti and force them out of the Sanrach Basin. To protect the western Thindolese from further serpentfolk infiltration, Samar conceals the roads and mountain passes to the west in illusions.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 92

events.text: Separated from eastern Thindol, the western Thindolese name their land Samarach after their savior and treat themselves as a vassal state of Nimbral. The eastern Thindolese remain as the realm of Thindol, governed by a council formed by each city.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 92

events.text: Coramshan is founded.
cites: Calimport, с. 14

events.text: The ranger Tara "Two-Blades" Oakfeller returns to Silverymoon to find her entire family dead. She discovers that Mayor Torus has been sacrificing all of his political and financial rivals to evil deities. Tara kills Torus and takes his place as mayor.
cites: The North: Guide to the Savage Frontier: Cities & Civilization, с. 47

events.text: High Queen Miranda Cymrych of the Moonshae Isles dies of natural causes.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 32

events.text: Embro Cymrych I becomes High King of the Moonshae Isles.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 32

events.text: Reinhar VI of Dambrath is born.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 77–78

events.text: Dwarves surge out of the mountains to overrun the orc kingdom of Vastar, slaying Orc-King Grimmerfang. Vastar falls and the survivors are driven north and south into the mountain peaks.
cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 42
Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 2nd edition (revised): A Grand Tour of the Realms, с. 71
The City of Ravens Bluff, с. 143–144

events.text: The victorious dwarves claim the surface lands for themselves and found the kingdom of Roldilar, the Realm of Glimmering Swords, under the rule of Deep King Tuir Stonebeard.
cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 42
Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 2nd edition (revised): A Grand Tour of the Realms, с. 71
The City of Ravens Bluff, с. 143–144

events.text: The Everhorde orcs pour out of the Spine of the World and rampage across the North, plunging the region into war. Yarlith is ruined, as is Illusk, though the Host Tower survives. Neverwinter is also spared, with the help of Palarandusk the Sun Dragon.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 92

events.text: On Evermeet, Amlaruil Moonflower is born.
cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 42

events.text: The members of the Pentad Retreat become sharn after the traitorous precept, the vampire wizard Palron Kaeth, used the orcs of the Everhorde to attack the hidden enclave of Miyeritar.
cites: Blackstaff: MMP, с. 182–189

events.text: The dwarf realm of Roldilar begins construction of Sarbreen.
cites: The City of Ravens Bluff, с. 2–3

events.text: Blackstaff, chapter 20.
cites: Blackstaff: MMP, с. 182–189

events.text: The Everhorde orcs are soundly defeated south of the site of future Triboar in the Battle of Firetears by the forces of Phalorm and allied powers of the North. The victory costs many lives, however, including the king of Ardeep, Lathlaeril "Leafspear".
cites: Dungeon 73: Eye of Myrkul, с. 24
Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 138
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 92

events.text: The spellbook The Hand of Helm goes missing at the Battle of Firetears. None know if its owner Helbrace Orthon gave it to someone else, hid it away, or simply lost it.
cites: Dragon 164: Pages From the Mages, Part VI, с. 62

events.text: The Granitefang tribe of orcs begins several concerted raids on Silverymoon. The tuskers establish a camp in the hills to the east for ease of access.
cites: The North: Guide to the Savage Frontier: Cities & Civilization, с. 47

events.text: Already seriously harmed by the Everhorde, Phalorm is assaulted by two more orc hordes. The orcs sack Dolblunde. The dwarf king of Phalorm, Oskilar, is killed in battle with the second horde. After dealing with remnants of the Everhorde, Phalorm's northern armies move south to the kingdom's defense, but are forced to retreat into Uthtower.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 93

events.text: High King Embro Cymrych I of the Moonshae Isles dies following an accident.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 32

events.text: Embro Cymrych II becomes High King of the Moonshae Isles.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 32

events.text: Hlondeth once again gains its independence from Chondath. House Extaminos rules Hlondeth from behind the scenes.

Responding to Uthtower's plea for help, the lich Iniarv uses powerful magic to raise the level of a portion of the Sea of Swords, which floods the kingdom of Uthtower, killing untold numbers of humanoids and creating the Mere of Dead Men when the waters recede.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 93

events.text: Iniarv's flood wipes out the armies of Uthtower, Phalorm, and the orc hordes besieging them. As the surviving orcs flee into the Sword Mountains, the elves of Phalorm retreat to Evermeet. Already wounded by orc attacks, the Tri-Crowned Kingdom of Phalorm falls.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 93
City of Splendors: Waterdeep, с. 8

events.text: With the retreat of the elves of Phalorm, Ardeep is only nominally an elf realm.
The lamia Nessmara takes the form of a gynosphinx and seduces Lyonarth, the "Winter Sphinx", ruler of Westgate. The two rule the city together.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 93

events.text: Abadda Moonglamaer, the Unicorn Prince of Phalorm, dies and is interred in the royal crypts beneath the Uthtower.
cites: Dungeon 73: Eye of Myrkul, с. 45

events.text: Following the fall of Phalorm, its human kingdom, Delimbiyran, lays claim to all the former lands of Phalorm and renames itself the Kingdom of Man. Delimbiyran makes alliances with the gnomes and halflings of the region.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 93

events.text: A wizard called the Handweaver arrives in Westgate and dispels the illusions concealing the ruling gynosphinx Nessmara, revealed her to actually be a lamia. Lyonarth, the androsphinx ruler she seduced and deceived, battles Nessmara to the death of both. Farnath, an apprentice of the Handweaver, is declared king of Westgate, beginning Ilistar Dynasty.

The shadow dragon Aurgloroasa, the "Sibilant Shade", moves from the lair of her mother, Shhuusshuru, to make her own lair in the southwestern Thunder Peaks. She would not intervene in the area for the next century.
cites: Cult of the Dragon, с. 40

events.text: Construction is completed of the dwarven fortress city of Sarbreen, by the kingdom of Roldilar in the Vast.
cites: The City of Ravens Bluff, с. 2–3

events.text: Circa: Selûne appears in the dreams of several assembled priests, informing them of the existence of a relic called the Moonweb, which was lost in the fall of Netheril. Two of these priests already have two of the four rings that make up the relic and together quest for the remaining two in secret.
cites: Prayers from the Faithful, с. 64

events.text: Lyonarth, the King of Westgate, dies.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 86

events.text: An unexplained bloating disease breaks out in Dambrath, killing one-tenth of the Arkaiun people, including King Reinhar IV.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 93

events.text: Reinhar V succeeds his father as king.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 77–78

events.text: Lalondra Worul creates the True Servants of Shar, a sisterhood of especially skilled and cruel priestesses. She uses dark magic to tie their life forces to her own so as to prevent betrayal.
cites: Prayers from the Faithful, с. 34

events.text: Belhendar Ilistar, a future King of Westgate, is born.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 86

events.text: Warren Cymrych II, future High King of the Moonshae Isles, is born to Samuel Cymrych.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 32

events.text: A horde of orcs attacks the elven empire of Cormanthyr and the Dalelands from the west, with Semberholme threatened with destruction. The combined forces of the elven armies and the Dalesman militia push back the invading forces at the Thunderpeak Mountains. The battle was commemorated in the ballad "Battlestars at Tilver's Gap".
cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 42
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 93

events.text: Mayor Tara "Two-Blades" Oakfeller of Silverymoon dies of a fever. Donal "the Wise Bear" Ethen, a popular local wizard replaces her.
cites: The North: Guide to the Savage Frontier: Cities & Civilization, с. 47

events.text: The dwarves abdicate the government of Khôltar, leaving a power vacuum. After many days of bloody conflict between prominent human families (the Onsruur), Embran Orntathtar leads the garthraun (police) to quell the violence and declare himself the first Belarkh (ruling lord).
cites: Elminster Speaks archive, с. 86
Elminster Speaks: Part 65: Khôltar, Part 16, A Brief History of Khôltar, Part 3

events.text: The ruins of Tzindylspar are struck by a third earthquake, leaving many of its monstrous inhabitants dead.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 93

events.text: Princess Bridget of Callidyrr and her entourage disappear while traveling to Norland. Due to marry Prince Scothgar of Rogarsheim in a political union, Bridget's disappearance sours diplomatic efforts between the Ffolk and the Northlanders.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 27

events.text: Ffolk from the Moonshae Isles arrive in the Utter East. They begin to subjugate the native Mar tribes and colonize the land.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 93

events.text: Led by Chief Umggok, the Granitefang tribe of orcs founds a village in the Moonwood.
cites: The North: Guide to the Savage Frontier: Cities & Civilization, с. 47

events.text: Donal "the Wise Bear" Ethen steps down as mayor of Silverymoon and begins building a public library. He suggests an elven friend of his, Paulorin Felinaun, as his replacement.
cites: The North: Guide to the Savage Frontier: Cities & Civilization, с. 47

events.text: Narfell launches a seaborne invasion of Mulhorand.
cites: Dragon Soargar's Legacy, с. 87

events.text: The sword Ashram comes into the possession of a Narfelli warrior.
cites: Dragon Soargar's Legacy, с. 87

events.text: Amlaruil Moonflower, while a young child, watches the Spelljammer glide over Evermeet's northern coast.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 93
The Radiant Dragon, с. 122–123

events.text: The city of Escalant on the Wizard's Reach secedes from the Untheric Empire. It then joins the League of Samathar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 93

events.text: In the kingdom of Impiltur, House Orbil assassinates King Bellodar I and attempts to seize power. The revolt is brutally crushed, and House Orbil is exiled from the kingdom and declared outlaw. King Bellodar II becomes the next king of Impiltur.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 93

events.text: Prince Ereskas of Amn establishes the settlement of Mirabar. It lays over the old dwarf capital of Gharraghaur.
Rowland Cymrych, future High King of the Moonshae Isles, is born to Alec Cymrych I.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 32

events.text: Ecamane Truesilver and his nine apprentices are led to Silverymoon by the goddesses Eldath, Mielikki, Lurue, Mystra, and Sehanine, or so they claim. Arriving there, they established a school of magic based on elven teachings.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 93

events.text: The Kanchai Temple is established within the Inner City of Dojyu.
cites: Kara-Tur: The Eastern Realms: Volume II, с. 133

events.text: An assassination attempt on King Draxius Obarskyr of Cormyr by Luthax, senior member of the War Wizards, and Elmariel Emmarask is foiled by Thanderahast and Amedahast, at the cost of Amedahast's life. Thanderahast, her apprentice, takes her position as High Mage.
cites: Cormyr: A Novel: Paperback 1998, с. 274–280
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 93

events.text: Amedahast dies in a magical explosion when she detonates her own staff, killing many others in the brotherhood of the War Wizards, although the fate of Luthax is not clear.
cites: Cormyr: A Novel: Paperback 1998, с. 279–280

events.text: The shape-changing slyth of the Underdark, build the city of Fluvenilstra in the Lowerdark under the Shaar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 93

events.text: The Granitefang tribe of orcs attack Silverymoon Town once more, breaching its defenses; the nonhumans are successfully turned back and forced southwards, where they are harried even further by elves near the settlement of Everlund. The conflict is later remembered as the battle of Thadanthiir’s Bridge.
cites: The North: Guide to the Savage Frontier: Cities & Civilization, с. 48

events.text: Shou Lung is struck by a wasting sickness, especially in the southern provinces. Local lords are granted additional powers in order to deal with the crisis.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 93

events.text: Chardansearavitriol , an old black dragon, makes his lair in the ruins of the Uthtower. Chardansearavitriol begins to dominate the Mere of Dead Men and nearby lands.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 93

events.text: Warlord Kieth of Silverymoon is given leadership over the settlement by its Mayor, Artus Natek, in the face of continued skirmishes with the Granitefang tribe.
cites: The North: Guide to the Savage Frontier: Cities & Civilization, с. 48

events.text: In Eleint, Iyraclea the Ice Queen sends an army commanded by the lich Vrandak the Burnished to lay siege to Myth Ondath, and raises great winter storms that lash the city throughout the year. This attack is called the Ice Queen's Winter.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 93

events.text: In the Moonshae Isles, King Stromm of Norland battles the Ffolk of Callidyrr.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 32

events.text: Thanks to her assault on Myth Ondath, Iyraclea's power becomes common knowledge and her claim to be greatest cleric of Auril is proven. Auril grants Iyraclea with new and more powerful cold-based magic.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 93

events.text: The Great Glacier, the home of Iyraclea, swells as a result of her frosty power.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 93

events.text: High King Embro Cymrych II of the Moonshae Isles dies in battle against King Stromm of Norland.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 32

events.text: Alec Cymrych I becomes High King of the Moonshae Isles.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 32

events.text: After working for years, Demron finishes Keryvian, the most powerful of the Baneblades. Demron becomes extremely exhausted after completing the sword, and perishes two days later. Due to his great work in the city, House Ammath and others finance a grand temple to Azuth, who Demron worshiped.
cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 42

events.text: After a year-long siege, Iyraclea uses the Gatekeeper's Crystal and utterly destroys the city of Myth Ondath, including its mythal.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 93

events.text: A Talassan heretic named Tothur appears in the western Shaar, displaying the Chanting Chain, a holy relic of Talos. Orthodox Talassans attack him continuously for more than 200 years but his success, powers and extended lifespan seem to prove his piety over the church and a scattered cult forms around his teachings in the Shaar and the Tashalar.
cites: Prayers from the Faithful, с. 18

events.text: The shadow dragon clan of Clan Jaezred was deposed by its own half-drow/half–shadow dragon offspring. The shadow great wyrm Haerinvureem, "Shimmergloom", flees the fighting by slipping into the Shadow Plane.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 93

events.text: King Bellodar II marches on the city-state of Chessagol. War is averted when King Lamoth of Chessagol offers his daughter to be wed to Prince Bellodar III and offers Impiltur a massive dowry.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 79
Dragon 277: Bazaar of the Bizarre: Soargar's Legacy

events.text: Ammathtar is destroyed in mysterious circumstances. Unbeknownst to all at the time, an evil beholder inside the Southern Lluirwood is behind it.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 93

events.text: Known as a great teacher of magic, Ecamane Truesilver is elected the ruler of Silverymoon, as High Mage.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 93

events.text: Rumors spread through Halruaan cities of a temple to Grumbar hidden in the West Wall.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 93

events.text: Worship of Gorellik falls off among the gnoll tribes of the Shaar as the cult of Yeenoghu rises to prominence.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 93

events.text: The gnolls of the Shaar attack many towns around Lake Lhespen. Lhesper is ruined.
Saber-toothed tigers make frequent attacks on the people of Ormath and Lheshayl and patrols from the Shining Plains.
The refugees of Lhesper migrate northward and found Shaarmid.
The trading and mining camps that will eventually grow into Zhentil Keep are established.

cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 32

events.text: Nytholops becomes the Mage King of Milvarn.

events.text: Nezram, a wizard of Mulhorand, vacates his tower on the edge of Lake Azulduth and leaves to explore other worlds.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 93
Old Empires, с. 5

events.text: Jungle barbarians making incursions into southern Shou Lung lead to a native of T'u Lung being appointed captain of a Shou Lung garrison post. This is the start of increasing numbers of southerners rising to prominence in the army over the next five centuries.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 94

events.text: Abadda Moonglamaer betrayed by Chardansearavitriol and imprisoned in the Vaults of the Uthlords in Uthtower.
cites: Dungeon 73: Eye of Myrkul, с. 45–46

events.text: In Kozakura, during the Night of Burning Flowers, the sohei of Sun Temple destroy the Seven Swords clan.

events.text: Reinhar VI becomes king of Dambrath.

events.text: When the nations of the Five Kingdoms of the Utter East discover the bloodforges of old, each kingdom sends legions of enchanted golems against each other, thus beginning the Bloodforge Wars.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 94

events.text: The Zakura Insurrection against the government of Kozakura officially ends.
cites: Swords of the Daimyo, с. 16

events.text: Baron Hurst Amadin dies in an orc attack on his High Castle west of Semberholme.
cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 42

events.text: Above and below ground, vast hordes of orcs engulf the dwarf realm of Roldilar, the Realm of Glimmering Swords. Drow also strike from the subterranean ways. Deep King Tuir Stonebeard leads the dwarven armies against those of the orcs and goblins, but they are defeated at Viperstongue Ford. Roldilar's defenses are broken, and the dwarves retreat to Mount Grimmerfang. This ends in the bloody, 20-day-long Battle of Deepfires beneath the mountain, and the fall of Roldilar.

The City of Ravens Bluff, с. 144
Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 3rd edition, с. 215

events.text: Human and elven allies save the Roldilarren dwarves from total extinction. The elven warrior Beluar and his forces rout the orcs at Viperstongue Ford, then pursue them through the hills later known as Beluar's Hunt and into the village of Maskyr's Eye to slay the last orc.

Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 2nd edition (revised): A Grand Tour of the Realms, с. 74

events.text: Following their defeat, four-fifths of all merrow in Serôs are forced to flee south to the other side of the Sharksbane Wall. The rest survive on the Hmur Plateau or living amidst the ruins on the Haunted Plains.
A great number of human and elf druid enclaves are founded throughout Cormanthyr and across wider Faerûn.

The Ninth Serôs War sees the destruction of the merrow Axe Kingdoms of Khuur and Nmalk, lying along the Dragon Coast and the coast of modern Sembia. Their fall sees the end of merrow civilization in Serôs.

events.text: The cities of Lapaliiya unite under the Lapal League, with Sheirtalar again selected as its capital.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 94

events.text: During the Ninth Serôs War, merrow invade the sahuagin realm of Aleaxtis, joining the other races already that have already invaded. cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 94

events.text: The Circle of Flames finishes writing the Scrolls Ardentym. The Circle keeps the full version for itself, and the Srinshee receives a complete copy. Six incomplete copies are delivered to scholars and strategists of the Akh'Faer.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 94

events.text: The Five Kingdoms of the Utter East are invaded by an army of primordial fiends and undead. Grand Caliph Arash bint Sanjar of Zakhara orders his armies in to wipe out the monsters and people alike. The Five Kingdoms are left in ruins, with razed cities and decaying corpses.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 94, 95

events.text: In secrecy, a portal is made to link the Underhalls of Mount Melairbode and the Hall of the Naturalists in Myth Drannor.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 94

events.text: The famed Cormyrean mage and explorer Rathdaen returns to Myth Drannor after several decades. He is close friends with many magic-users there.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 94

events.text: Ecamane Truesilver sends the wizard Tulrun to the Incanistaeum in Myth Drannor to learn magic from the Seven Wizards.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 94

events.text: Many wizards, from Myth Drannor and elsewhere, begin moving to the city of Silverymoon. This would later establish its relationship as a "sister city" to Myth Drannor, and as a center of learning.

events.text: From the Small Teeth, the Horned Mage raises an army that sacks the towns of Imnescar and Trademeet in Amn. General Rashturl of Amn leads an army against them, halting the Horned Mage's advance. The Horned Mage disappears, his fate unknown.

events.text: On the final day of the Midsummer festivals, Coronal Eltargrim Irithyl of Myth Drannor dies, leaving the leadership of the city open, and ushering in The Dusk. Eltargrim leaves the Ruler's elfblade, the Ar'Cor'Kerym, hovering about the Rule Tower. His niece and heir Aravae Irithyl declares a five-year-long period of mourning for the whole city. This marks end of the Sixth Rysar of Cormanthyr.

events.text: Rathdaen, a great mage and friend of many of Myth Drannor's inhabitants, dies in his sleep. His apprentice Narsel inherits the Tome of Rathdaen, and immediately journeys west, fearful of attacks by jealous rivals attempting to steal Rathdaen's legacy.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 94

events.text: The heirs of Houses Bleth, Crownsilver and Truesilver are killed while adventuring in the hideaway called the Auantiver Labyrinth. The fashionable practice of young Cormyrian noble scions exploring the Labyrinth ends as a result.
Strohm I's grandson, Strohm II takes the throne of Tethyr.
cites: Lands of Intrigue: Erlkazar and Folk of Intrigue, с. 28

events.text: In Myth Drannor, House Starym covertly assassinate Coronal Aravae Irithyl and her personal guards. The Srinshee and the mages of High Court insist on continuing the mourning period of the previous coronal, Eltargrim Irithyl, and add on the funeral of Aravae Irithyl. Meanwhile, they work to prevent a war of succession between the nobles of Cormanthyr.

Chaos ensues, with many elves, humans and other people of Myth Drannor slain and the Rule Tower destroyed. Finally, the Srinshee claims the Crownblade and restores the Rule Tower, but vanishes with the elfblade.

events.text: The noted elf archmage and planewalker Abarat the Alabaster resigns his position as head of the Six Tyryl Towers wizard school in Myth Drannor. He announces his intention to construct a new tower in the Beast Lands (later Thar). He does just that, fashioning a magically strengthened ivory tower to defend against the local tribes and link the local elf nations as a hub of commerce and travel.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 96

events.text: Southern barbarians invade Shou Lung and overrun Kahgang Su and the We'peng garrison. The clan militias and mercenary forces that gather to resist them outnumber those of the Emperor for the first time in Shou Lung's history. However, the invasion is suddenly abandoned and the barbarians depart, perhaps for the death or disappearance of their leader. Nevertheless, the local military forces stay in place.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 96

events.text: Following an incursion of drow in north-west Cormanthor, Spell-Major Paeris Haladar enters the Vault of Ages in Myth Drannor, the first time years that anyone has stepped foot inside. But Paeris finds the vault empty, all the great and ancient treasures of Cormanthyr missing.

During the construction of an ivory tower in Thar, Abarat the Alabaster contacts his former colleagues and begs for their assistance against a siege by a monstrous army. Help arrives in a matter of hours, but rescuers find the tower entirely empty, with Abarat and all the monsters gone, no sign of a battle or anything out of the ordinary. Abarat is never heard of again, while the incomplete tower becomes known as Abarat's Folly.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 96

events.text: The gnolls of the Shaar are rent by internal strife. Their raids into the Lapal League dramatically decline.

Many dwarves of Myth Drannor—the majority refugee clans from the fallen kingdom of Roldilar in the neighboring Vast—migrate north to the southern coast of the Dragon Sea. There they reopen the westernmost mines of Sarphil near Tailings Bay.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 96

events.text: King Bellodar III of Impiltur dies of natural causes.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 79

events.text: The mages Aganazzar, Grimwald, Ilyykur, and Presper found the Covenant, an alliance of mages with the aim of promoting peace among the human nations of the North and preparing them for future battles with the orcs.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 96

events.text: Elves, half-elves, and humans build the town of Hillsafar (named for the Hillsafar dwarf clan) on the western shore of Tailings Bay. Their main aim is to trade with the dwarves of the Scarp, but some of the founders seek to keep the area free of drow and to watch over Moander's Crypt. Many less established crafts-folk of Myth Drannor migrate to Hillsafar seeking opportunity and work.
Following the death of his father, Morus becomes the new king of Impiltur.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 79

cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 32

cites: The Ruins of Myth Drannor: Campaign Guide to Myth Drannor, с. 18
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 96

events.text: After descending into madness, King Morus of Impiltur accuses his brother, Alathos I of attempting to seize the Golden Throne. The two duel one another in a sword-fight and Alathos slays his brother. He is crowned as the new king of the Realm of the Sword and the Wand.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 79

events.text: The noble House Ulondarr scandalizes Myth Drannor by openly accepting half-elves in the line of succession to lead the house. For half a century, Ulondarr is censured and harassed by the other houses, some of whom send mercenaries and assassins against them.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 96

events.text: Taeral Olortynaal returns to the Incanistaeum in Myth Drannor and rejoins the Seven Wizards of Myth Drannor. However, a politically motivated spell-battle breaks out between several noble elves and humans, and Taeral and two human students are accidentally killed by gold elf students. These students frame the only surviving non-elf, Arlesn of Arabel. Although innocent, Arlesn is exiled from Myth Drannor and the students are never charged.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 96

events.text: Dogmen of the Shaar, a book written by Dhynthar of Kormul, is published.
cites: The Candlekeep Collection

events.text: Hym Kraaven, a senior member of the Seven Wizards of Myth Drannor, discovers the truth of Taeral Olortynaal's death in a spell-battle the previous year. He is soon killed in a supposed wild tavern brawl by agents and allies of the ambitious young mages of House Faerondarl.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 96

events.text: The Wizards' Reach rebels against Unther, so Gilgeam sends a naval armada to quell them. However, the fleet is wracked by a huge storm and returns without result.

Lord Councilor Kharis Maerdrym leads a hunting party, including several notable humans, in a Grand Hunt of an almost legendary greater quelzarn. However, the group vanishes off the coast of Delthuntle. Some suspect agents of Unther or political rivals of Maerdrym attacked them.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 96

events.text: An army of monsters bred by a deepspawn emerges from the Beast Marches and nearly destroys Hillsafar. Cormanthyr sends the Akh'Velahr to reinforce Hillsafar, and they drive the monsters off by winter. They leave a garrison to defend Hillsafar and the northern forests and settlements until Myth Drannor falls in 714 DR.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 96

events.text: After a long and expensive campaign, Unther formally recognizes the League of Samathar, a group of cities on the Wizard's Reach that had seceded from the empire. Unther cannot recover from the campaign and the Second Untheric Empire ends.

events.text: A decade after Halaster Blackcloak secretly abducted wizards from across Cormanthyr, in return for them plundering monsters from Undermountain, the Guild of Naturalists finally work out what happened. The Guild sends an team to rescue the wizards, but they never return. The Guild quietly abandons its expeditions into the dungeon. However, all efforts to destroy the portal linking the guild's hall and Undermountain fail.

events.text: The Seven Wizards of Myth Drannor are suddenly disbanded when Mentor Wintercloak and the Masked leave with the last four students, all gnomes. They depart in Wintercloak's old stone tower, which suddenly rises out of the ground and flies away to the north-north-west. The last of the Seven, Sakaala of the Seven Rings, is left in sole control of the Incanistaeum.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 96

cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 97

events.text: Clan Tarystone, a 350-strong dwarven community, is discovered tunneling under Myth Drannor despite an old agreement that the region under the City of Song is not to be disturbed. When word becomes more widespread, several elven houses claim the new tunnels have collapsed some ancient elven burial vaults and crypts. As a result, the clan is exiled from Myth Drannor and Cormanthyr and emigrates west towards the Thunder Peaks.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 97

events.text: Carthus Cymrych, future High King of the Moonshae Isles, is born to Ernest Cymrych.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 33

events.text: A cabal of seers based in Windsong Tower, the Dark Diviners, discover the Book of the Black while investigating the Fane of Shadows. This tome, containing the Black Chronology penned (in part) by Augathra the Mad, is brought back to their tower for intensive study. The diviners write the Leaves of One Night as a treatise to their new insights into Shar and her dark secrets. The goddess curses both tomes and sends agents to steal them away from the wizards. The texts disappear for centuries.

Raanaghaun Cormrael, one of the Dark Diviners of Windsong Tower, gates to the Plane of Shadow, seeking more secrets such as those revealed by the Book of the Black. He never returns. Simultaneously, his sister Shar Cormrael, discovers clues in Windsong Tower that lead her to the fallen Netherese city of Synod. There she finds Augathra the Mad just as she was completing a ritual to become a sharn. The interruption causes Augathra, Shar Cormrael, and a spying phaerimm to be bound together into a new sharn. The resulting magical energy drew in other phaerimms, who created a colony in the ruins of Synod to study and torture this strange sharn.

cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 86

events.text: In Shou Lung, the last Emperor Chin of the Kao Dynasty, along with his family, dies in a fire that razes the old Imperial City. Ton Bor, the emperor's third cousin, is named the first Emperor Chin of the Yin Dynasty, meaning "Silver". Instead, Shou history records it as the La Dynasty, meaning "Wax" for its malleability. Rival factions and secret societies influence the La emperors, and it is time of rampant corruption and poor management.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 103

events.text: In Myth Nantar, the shields around the Academy of the Dukars, having slowly expanded since the city's collapse in 720 DR, now cause the city's mythal to become impenetrable to all matter and magic, permitting only water, corals, fish, and sea stars. When it is touched, the mythal appears to emit a haunting song. The legend arises that the city and the Dukars are cursed until they perform for all the races of Serôs. Over the five centuries, fewer and fewer people come to Myth Nantar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 103

events.text: The Eleventh Serôs War comes to an end with the fall of the sea elf kingdom of Keryvyr, but Nyratiis, the would-be-coronal who triggered the war, flees and evades capture. Keryvyr's allies, Naramyr and Selu Maraar, remain intact.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 112

events.text: Drow raid cities all down the Sword Coast, carrying many human inhabitants of the Dessarin Valley off into slavery. The drow pillage and raze the tiny realms of Harpshield and Talmost beside the Ardeep Forest.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 112

events.text: Emurra Scaradath, the young protégé of the Moonseer of Waterdeep, Engalathae, rouses the Selûnite clergy of the city into sending a rescue mission into the Underdark to rescue her family and the Moonseer who were captured by drow slavers.
cites: Prayers from the Faithful, с. 64

events.text: The Ffolk are victorious in repelling a giant and firbolg incursion in Myrloch Vale. The Sword of Cymrych Hugh is carried off by surviving firbolgs.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 27

events.text: High King Tanner Cymrych of the Moonshae Isles is killed battling the firbolg chieftain.

Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 33

events.text: The Ffolk capitulate to the Illuskan invading settlers, ceding the northern Moonshae Isles to "the Northmen". This marks the end of the reign of the High Kings.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 27
Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 33

events.text: The heir of the last High King Tanner, Niall, changes the family name from Cymrych to Carrathal as he assumes rule only over the realm of Callidyrr. Following suit, the various other noble families of the Moonshaes begin to change the spellings and pronunciations of their surnames to distance themselves from the Cymrych name, giving rise to the distinct Cambridge, Cyric, Kendrick, Kimball, Kincaid, Riker, and Selkirk families.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 33
Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 31

events.text: The hero Tyndal, now a wealthy merchant, weds Eleesa, heir to the Duke of Calandor.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 112

events.text: The silver dragon Teskulladar "Manytalons" and the white dragon Cortulorrulagalargath battle above the realm of Calandor, doing much damage to the land below. The defeated and dying Cortulorrulagalargath crashes into Delimbiyran, killing the Duke of Calandor and his retinue.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 112

events.text: The Duke of Calandor's new son-in-law, Tyndall is named duke. He shifts his seat of power to the former Barony of the Steeping Falls, and begins construction of Castle Daggerford over the ruins of Morlin Castle.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 112

events.text: Jhentyr Campion II, a future King of Westgate, is born.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 86

events.text: Almost one hundred cells of the Cult of the Dragon now exist across Faerûn, the height of the Cult's power to date.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 112

cites: Lands of Intrigue: Erlkazar and Folk of Intrigue, с. 29

events.text: The orcs of Uruth Ukrypt destroy Phandalin, a vital farming center lying southwest of the Old Owl Well. They go on to sack nearby Wave Echo Cave in order to seize the magical treasures of the gnomes and dwarves of Phandelver's Pact.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 112

events.text: The Second Trollwar between the humans of Waterdeep, allied with cities of the North, and the trolls of the Evermoors comes to an end. First, the Waterdhavian defenders drive the trolls back from their walls. The human realms then unite under Aeroth, War Captain of Silverymoon; Ahghairon of Waterdeep; and Samular Caradoon of Tyr, and together they eradicate trolls across the Evermoors. The might of the trolls is ultimately broken during a nine-day fight known as the Long Battle. Renwick Caradoon, the wizard brother of Samular, falls in the final battle but rises as an archlich. Ahghairon the mage used his magical prowess to turn the war against the trolls.

events.text: Tchazzar, the warlord of Chessenta, leads an assault on the cities of the Wizards' Reach. Some are conquered, while others make separate peace treaties and become tributary states. This leads to the fall of the League of Samathar.

events.text: As an orc horde gathers in the Spine of the World, the mages of the Covenant muster an army from the human realms of the North to face them. However, in an action dubbed the "Orcgates Affair", the Red Wizards of Thay use great portals to magically transport the orcs far to the south. The North is spared, but the Covenant are embarrassed by the orc's failure to show.

events.text: A month after work starts on Castle Waterdeep, the traitors Aviss and Fellandar lead an army of trolls out of the Mere of Dead Men against Waterdeep and the castle in a planed third Trollwar. cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 27

events.text: A Cult of the Dragon cell in the city of Surkh trespasses on the territory of a similar cult worshiping Tiamat, the Dragon Queen. The Tiamatans caused an abrupt halt to the Cult's expansion south.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 113

events.text: A Tashlutan priestess of Loviatar, Althatha Ammaeritus, recovers the Lash of Loviatar, which has been lost for forty-two years. Althatha proceeds to attack the Tashalaran 'pleasure houses' run by senior members of the clergy but is overwhelmed while storming the sixth such building.
cites: Prayers from the Faithful, с. 45–46

events.text: Derro tribes across the Northdark gather in the Uniting War against the duergar of Gracklstugh. They slay King Barthorn V. His successor, King Tarngardt VII, responds with a crusade to eradicate the derro. The duergar enslave several hundred derro and take them back to Gracklstugh.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 113

events.text: Following its defeat in Surkh by the church of Tiamat in 971 DR, halting its southward expansion, the Cult of the Dragon refocuses attention on the north. Over the next twenty-three years, the cult establishes at least ten new cells, but fails to infiltrate Silverymoon.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 113

events.text: Following their failure in Surkh, disgruntled Cult members begin openly criticizing the leadership of Algashon and the heavy involvement of the church of Bane in Cult activity. The mage Tuelhalva Drakewings emerges as a prominent opponent of Bane's role in the Cult.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 113

events.text: In Dambrath, a horde of Crinti shadow marauders gathers and passes through the Nath Pass in order to raid towns in neighboring Halruaa. This touches off four years of skirmishing between the two realms.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 113

events.text: Whipmistress Superior Jalrathae is defeated by the High Holy Temptress Lauraera Dlarayna after Jalrathae wrests control of a dozen temples of Loviatar using the Lash of Loviatar.
cites: Prayers from the Faithful, с. 46

events.text: King Mhoaran the Tusk-Bearded of Tethyr dies.

The Covenant mages begin to subtly oppose the Red Wizards.

events.text: The tiefling Khamune leads an uprising in Pyarados against Mulhorand. His rebellion is crushed.
Khamune and Greta Zann are slain by the Mulhorandi.
The valley of Tasseldale is settled by humans.

events.text: The Elven Imperial Fleet destroys the planet Borka in Greyspace in the most destructive event of the First Unhuman War.
Rayuth, the Warlord of Silverymoon, passes away with old age. His son Tulven succeeds him, but he is proud and sadistic.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 113

events.text: Distasteful of Tulven, the famed war captain Aeroth of Silverymoon and his six sons depart Silverymoon and take the sword Taragarth with them. They ultimately settle in the Moonshae Isles.

events.text: The brothers Oswulf and Eldamar build their castle in the Dragonspine Mountains and the town of Verdigris grows up below it.
The Moonstar family is ennobled in Waterdeep.

Drow ambush a dwarven mining expedition traveling through tunnels of the Underdark beneath the Trackless Sea. During the fighting, a deep core fissure erupts, flooding a gallery with magma. Many are slain on each side, leaving only a handful of survivors, who each believe the other side has been wiped out. The battle becomes known as "Rockfire".
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 113

events.text: Cut off from the route back to mainland Faerûn, the dwarf and drow survivors of the Battle of Rockfire separately journey westward, under the entire ocean. Finally making the surface in Maztica, the dwarves emerge into the harsh desert of the Sands of Itzcala, while the drow arrive to south in the foothills of the Axapoztlan Range.

events.text: King Haedrak I of Tethyr is born.
cites: Lands of Intrigue: Erlkazar and Folk of Intrigue, с. 29

events.text: Under the leadership of Wai Fu Hong, a group of Shou Lung cities revolt against imperial taxes. Preferring not to let news of it spread, the imperial court decides to negotiate rather than put down the uprising. Nobles of T'u Lung perceive weakness and are encouraged.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 113

events.text: Dwarven miners from Thunderholme accidentally expand their works into the lair of the shadow dragon Aurgloroasa, rousing her from her sleep. She dispatches the dwarves and caves in their tunnel to make it appear as an accident. She becomes interested in Thunderholme's operations and observes the dwarves via divination magic and spies summoned from the Plane of Shadow.
cites: Cult of the Dragon, с. 39

events.text: Eldathyn priests fleeing their home in the Elven Court arrive in the Hullack Forest. These priests, carrying a relic called the Crystrum of Tranquility go on to purify the poisoned waters of the Wyvernwater in a ritual that claims the life of their high priestess.
cites: Prayers from the Faithful, с. 22

events.text: Tulven is stripped of his rank and position as Warlord of Silverymoon for his abuse of power. High Mage Threskaal makes the office of Warlord non-hereditary and furthermore makes it a temporary position filled only when the city had military need.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 113

cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 113

events.text: From the fissures in the Great Glacier, powerful demons—trapped under the ice since the time of Narfell—are freed. Sossrim warriors led by Londraeth, their ruler of Sossal, battle and slay the demons.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 113

events.text: The Harpers establish the Heralds of Faerûn for the purposes of keeping records and arbitrating heraldry, in order to anchor civilization keep communications clear. The Heralds growing influential and widespread, thanks to their firm impartiality.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 113

events.text: Lord Saros starts building Turmish's navy, making it one of the strongest sea powers in the Vilhon Reach.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 113

cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 113

events.text: The flooding by water elementals creates the Marsh of Chelimber.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 113

events.text: Lizardfolk tribes of the northern Serpent Hills migrate east into the Marsh of Chelimber.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 113

events.text: On Midsummer, a minor wizard named Naerlus "Flamespell" Arnarthandyer becomes the first wielder of the Scepter of Mystra after it was given to him by Meldryn Jalensifer, the Magister at the time, under the direct instruction of Mystra herself.
cites: Prayers from the Faithful, с. 77–78

events.text: Naerlus uses the Scepter to establish himself as a petty tyrant along the coast north of Leilon. Meldryn attempts to retrieve the relic but Naerlus accidentally loses it before Meldryn can take it back. Adventurers find the Scepter in Calimshan a few months later and sell it. Winding up in the hands of five wizards, they battle for the relics ownership but lose it the same way Naerlus did.
cites: Prayers from the Faithful, с. 77–78

events.text: A wizard named Taluth casts a meteor swarm spell in Telflamm, tearing apart the surrounding buildings, after he spots a doppelganger in an alleyway.
cites: Prayers from the Faithful, с. 77–78

events.text: The famous ranger hero Yornar "the Tracker" disappears. Although signs of his passing are found for the next three years, he is never seen again and no remains are ever found. Followers of Mielikki believe that he still lives as the personal servant of the goddess.
cites: Prayers from the Faithful, с. 117

events.text: The Scepter of Mystra is found by a Calishite mage named Kloroth of the Seven Curses. While using it to build a portal, he is afflicted with an eighth curse that continually polymorphs him into different creatures. He loses the Scepter in Selgaunt and retreats into hiding. By dawn of the next day, it is back in the hands of Naerlus Arnarthandyer, who had fled from the enemies he'd made three years ago.
cites: Prayers from the Faithful, с. 78–79

events.text: Naerlus is killed by a mind flayer when he falls into a portal to Skullport.
cites: Prayers from the Faithful, с. 78–79
